description: Eight XSS payloads (X1–X8) drawn from the OWASP XSS Filter Evasion Cheat Sheet, mapped to the eight vectors in the app's security checklist (8.4.2). Each payload is a string that the app must render as text, never as markup. The fixture is the input to a rendering test: a task whose title, description, creator, or assignee is one of these payloads must display the payload as literal text and must not execute the script, load the image, or navigate the link.

X1_script_tag.label: Classic script tag
X1_script_tag.what_it_would_do_if_markup: Execute the script when the element is inserted into the DOM.

X2_img_onerror.label: Image onerror
X2_img_onerror.what_it_would_do_if_markup: Attempt to load a broken image, then execute the onerror handler.

X3_svg_onload.label: SVG onload
X3_svg_onload.what_it_would_do_if_markup: Execute the onload handler when the SVG is parsed.

X4_iframe_javascript.label: Iframe with javascript: URL
X4_iframe_javascript.what_it_would_do_if_markup: Load an iframe whose src is a javascript: URL, executing the alert in the iframe's context.

X5_a_javascript.label: Anchor with javascript: href
X5_a_javascript.what_it_would_do_if_markup: Render a clickable link that executes JavaScript when clicked.

X6_body_onload.label: Body onload
X6_body_onload.what_it_would_do_if_markup: Execute the onload handler when the body is parsed.

X7_div_onmouseover.label: Div onmouseover
X7_div_onmouseover.what_it_would_do_if_markup: Execute the onmouseover handler when the user hovers the div.

X8_style_expression.label: CSS expression (legacy IE)
X8_style_expression.what_it_would_do_if_markup: In legacy IE, evaluate the expression when the style is applied. In modern browsers this is inert, but it is still a vector that a filter would have to recognise.
